Injection_Payloads:
// SAVE SYSTEM — HOW PROGRESSION IS PROTECTED //
◈ LAYER 1 — LOCAL SAVE (OFFLINE / ALWAYS ON)

Every meaningful event (coin pickup, purchase, wave clear, tree upgrade, prestige, run end) calls saveGame(), which writes the full progression blob to localStorage['neonhell_save'] instantly — no network needed. A timestamp is stored in localStorage['neonhell_saveTime'] and is what merge arbitration trusts for recency.

Local saves are per device / per browser profile. Clearing site data wipes this layer — that is what the cloud layer exists for.

◈ LAYER 2 — CLOUD SAVE (ONLINE / SIGNED IN)

Signing in with Google creates/opens a Firestore doc at saves/<uid>. After every local save, a cloud push is scheduled with a 3-second debounce (burst of pickups = one write). Critical moments (run end, prestige, purchases) call forceCloudSave() which pushes immediately.

Every cloud write also appends a history snapshot (2-min throttle, forced at critical moments, last 100 kept). Admin REWIND restores players from these.

◈ MERGE — WHY NOTHING GETS LOST

On sign-in, cloudLoad() scores BOTH sides with nhSaveScore() (prestige, highest wave, boss kills, skins, cards, trees, fusions, bonuses, log-scaled currencies). The higher score wins unless the gap is under 15%, then the most recent timestamp wins.

The merged result is never behind either side: collections (skins, cards, leaderboard, custom maps, name history) are UNIONED; upgrade levels, tree levels and achievement stats take the MAX per key; spendables (coins/gems/consumables) come from the winning timeline. The merge is applied locally AND pushed up, so both stores agree. A toast tells the player which side was ahead.

◈ OFFLINE PLAY WHILE SIGNED IN

Offline: the game runs purely on the local layer; cloud pushes silently no-op. When connectivity returns, the window 'online' event re-runs cloudLoad() → the same never-behind merge fires automatically, best progress wins, no prompts. If Firestore is unreachable at sign-in, a 12-second failsafe unlocks local saving so the player is never frozen out; the merge re-runs when the connection comes back.

◈ ACCOUNT SAFETY GUARDS

• fbCloudLoadPending — saveGame() and cloudSave() are blocked while a cloud load/merge is in flight (no half-loaded state can be written over the cloud).
• _nhMergeDone — cloud writes stay gated until the merge resolves, so a mid-merge push can never clobber the better save.
• _spectateMode — spectating never writes saves.
• Ban flags are checked at sign-in before any load/save happens.
• Name changes are kept in nameHistory (last 20) for impersonation/abuse review.

◈ WHAT SYNCs / WHAT STAYS PER-DEVICE

Synced: coins, gems, display name, skins + skin levels, cards + card levels, coin tree, gem tree, HP/magnet/XP bonuses, nukes, medkits, fusions, achievements (stats + unlocked), prestige, leaderboard entries, custom maps, season pass state, name history.
Per-device (by design): graphics preset + toggles, audio settings, FPS opt-in, device profile, wide-view pref — a phone and a PC keep their own comfort settings.
